network.scope: Pinned dependency bootstrap and official syllabus retrieval from the bounded hosts in security/network_policy.json.
network.reason: The isolated runtime needs pinned package installation, and handbook source acquisition needs the confirmed official exam-board or College Board host.

target_enforcement.generic: Explicit host allowlist and operator review
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace trust plus explicit host allowlist

file_write.scope: Versioned isolated runtime cache, atomic readiness marker, and the handbook output directory explicitly selected by the user.
file_write.reason: The packaged engine must persist official evidence, handbook artifacts, review ledgers, and hash-bound delivery files; bootstrap must create an isolated runtime without changing global Python.

target_enforcement.openai: Skill contract and operator-visible output path
target_enforcement.claude: Adapter metadata and operator-visible output path
target_enforcement.generic: Metadata fallback plus explicit output path

subprocess.scope: Python venv creation, pip dependency installation, packaged engine invocation, CLI health probe, and Playwright browser process used for approved PDF export.
subprocess.reason: Subprocess execution is required to keep the runtime isolated and preserve the existing CLI and PDF capabilities while exposing the exact command and exit status to the operator.
